instruction: Add a 'Period Rate (%)' column by calculating the period rate for every row as a number, then include a summary row at the bottom with the average period rate.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating period rate (Annual Rate / Period per year) for all 24 data rows and computing their average. Verified with Python script: average of all period rates = 3.6617775794 (sum 87.8826619048 / 24 rows). Custom getter extracts the average value from the row below the last data row. Metric checks if the calculated average matches expected value within 0.01 tolerance.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE VERIFICATION: Evaluator correctly verifies all 3 instruction requirements.

Requirement #1 (calculate period rate for EACH data row): Getter extracts all period rate values from rows 2 to last_data_row (xlsx.py:51-68), counts them (data_row_count), and metric verifies count == 24 (metrics/xlsx.py:25-28).

Requirement #2 (ensure all values are formatted as numbers): Getter checks if each value is numeric type using isinstance(cell_value, (int, float)) (xlsx.py:64-67) and sets all_values_numeric flag. Metric verifies this flag (metrics/xlsx.py:31-33).

Requirement #3 (add row to calculate average): Getter extracts average value from row after last data row (xlsx.py:70-72). Metric verifies average matches expected value within 0.01 tolerance (metrics/xlsx.py:36-45).

LOGICAL CORRECTNESS: Data flow is correct - getter extracts period rate column, counts numeric values, verifies all are numeric type, and extracts average. Metric performs three independent checks with appropriate failure handling (returns 0.0 if any requirement fails).
EDGE CASE HANDLING: Getter handles None values (xlsx.py:59-61), non-numeric values (xlsx.py:66-67), and missing average (xlsx.py:78). Metric handles missing/None values (xlsx.py:39-40).
POSTCONFIG: Appropriate postconfig present - activates window, saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure data is persisted before verification (evaluator.postconfig lines 30-59).
